excerpt: Compare ready and off-plan Abu Dhabi property by inspection, registration, payment timing, handover and the complete cost.
introduction:
A ready Abu Dhabi property can be inspected before purchase, while an off-plan property is bought under an agreement before completion. Compare the actual home, ownership right, total payments and the time at which you can use it. The most suitable choice depends on your move date, finances and tolerance for delivery risk.

The payment example below shows how instalments can be organised across a purchase.
takeaways: Inspect a ready home and check title, occupancy, building costs and clearance.
Verify an off-plan project's registration, contract, payment recipient and handover provisions.
Map every payment and confirm the buyer's right for the exact property before committing.

sections.heading: What can you inspect and verify?
sections.body:
For a ready apartment or villa, inspect the actual unit, common areas, parking and services. Review the title, seller authority, any mortgage or lease and current service charges. A completed building is not necessarily vacant or ready for immediate occupation.

For off-plan, request the registered project and unit, signed plan, specification, construction progress, payment schedule and handover terms. ADREC's [project development page](https://adrec.gov.ae/en/sectors/regulatory-services/project-development) describes project registration and oversight; confirm the current status and payment details for the exact development.

The [Al Reem and Al Raha family guide](/journal/al-reem-island-vs-al-raha-beach-for-family-living) shows why the location and building need their own assessment.

sections.heading: Compare the full payment schedule
sections.body:
Imagine an off-plan price of AED 1,000,000 with 20% at booking, 40% during construction and 40% at handover: AED 200,000, AED 400,000 and AED 400,000. This is a sample schedule, not an Abu Dhabi offer. Add transaction, finance, furnishing and other costs separately.

The chart shows components of the one assumed price. Put actual dates and triggers on a calendar, including current rent until the new home is ready. A low initial instalment does not remove the later balance.

For a ready home, confirm when the deposit, balance, loan and registration fees are due. Compare both calendars with available funds and a separate reserve.

Ask whether each instalment follows a calendar date or a construction milestone, and record the evidence required for payment.

sections.heading: Check ownership and registration
sections.body:
Ask ADREC or the relevant registrar to confirm the buyer's right for the exact property. The [Abu Dhabi expat buying guide](/journal/how-to-buy-property-in-abu-dhabi-as-an-expat) explains investment-area and registration checks. Verify the seller or developer's authority, any mortgage, lease and required clearance.

DARI's [off-plan unit sale service](https://services.dari.ae/company-services/off-plan-unit-sale-registration/?adrec=businessservices) describes registration of a sale of an under-construction unit. Confirm the current process, issued document and fees for the actual transaction. For a ready sale, ask which registration service applies.

Verify payment instructions through independently confirmed channels and retain the agreement, receipts and registration outcome. A reservation receipt alone is not a title deed.

sections.heading: Understand the delivery and payment protections
sections.body:
ADREC's [registration legislation](https://adrec.gov.ae/en/rules_and_regulations/registration) includes provisions concerning project escrow accounts and off-plan payments. Ask ADREC and the developer to confirm the current rules and account details for the exact project; later amendments or project circumstances can matter. Review the handover schedule and contract terms alongside the regulatory controls.

Read the contract's specification, payment triggers, delay, default, cancellation and resale provisions. Ask a qualified adviser to explain any term that is unclear. Keep dated project updates and evidence of the amounts paid.

Allow for existing housing costs if handover is delayed. Do not depend on a future sale or rent to make a contractual instalment unless you can manage without it.

sections.heading: Compare finance and ongoing costs
sections.body:
Request the lender's current offer for each property, including valuation, loan amount, fees, insurance and repayments. A developer plan and bank mortgage are different obligations. Test a lower valuation or delayed approval and keep enough cash for the difference.

Request the current service-charge statement for a ready unit or the basis of any estimate for a new building. Include utilities, insurance, repairs and management if the property will be let. The [Abu Dhabi buying cost guide](/journal/total-cost-of-buying-an-apartment-in-abu-dhabi) explains the broader budget.

A property should remain affordable after the initial deposit and under a less favourable scenario.

sections.heading: Check the intended use and exit
sections.body:
If buying a home, test the work and school routes and confirm access to facilities that matter to the household. If investing, seek recent signed leases and completed sales for comparable units, and deduct vacancy and owner costs. Keep asking prices separate from completed transactions.

Consider the time needed to sell, selling charges and any remaining loan or developer balance. Neither ready nor off-plan status guarantees capital growth or liquidity.

sections.heading: Compare the evidence behind the price
sections.body:
For a ready property, seek recent completed sales of similar units and inspect condition, floor, parking, view and any tenancy. Compare asking prices with completed sales of similar properties. Ask for the unit's current charge statement and any known work before deciding what a price difference means.

For off-plan, compare the contracted layout, specification, payment dates and expected handover with genuinely similar alternatives. Check whether a fee contribution or furnishing offer is conditional and what it would be worth to you. Neither an incentive nor the ability to spread payments establishes that the underlying price is competitive. Keep a dated record of the evidence and the remaining unknowns.

sections.heading: Request current options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Abu Dhabi project collection](/projects?emirate=Abu%20Dhabi) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget, nationality and intended use. Ask which ready and off-plan units are currently available and request their plans, terms and documents.

Verify ownership and current official requirements before signing or paying.
